plan.title: Exploratory robustness analyses R1 for prevalence-gated adaptation (PGA)
plan.status: exploratory: planned on 2026-10-21 after the confirmatory ASVspoof 2021 DF verdict (METHOD CONFIRMED) was known, before any robustness result was computed
plan.splits: identical to the confirmatory cells (same seeds, reference/traffic draws and fold assignments); added methods draw from an independent random stream
plan.gate: estimated spoof share (frozen score) >= 0.80, as pre-registered
plan.guard: adapt only if the gate is open AND bona_share(adapted calibration reference vs traffic) >= rho x bona_share(frozen); rho = 0.5 primary; rho in 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9 reported
plan.grouped_split: reference split into train / calibration halves by speaker
plan.nap: remove the top k = min(32, n_speakers - 1) principal directions of the train-reference speaker means (speakers with >= 2 clips) from all features before scaling
plan.pga_r: PGA-R = NAP + grouped split + gate + guard (rho 0.5), ssl1024 features
plan.nnpu: linear nnPU (beta 0, gamma 1), sigmoid loss, class prior = frozen bona-share estimate clipped to [0.01, 0.99], standardised features, full-batch Adam lr 1e-3, 300 steps, weight decay 1e-4, same 5-fold cross-fitting as the confirmatory method
plan.coral: frozen AASIST readout (score = w.emb160 + c, recovered by least squares from the stored scores and checked to 1e-2) on traffic-aligned emb160: CORAL (full covariance, eps = 1e-3 x mean variance) and diagonal mean/std alignment, both to ASVspoof 2019 LA eval statistics; alignment estimated on the unlabelled traffic only
plan.oracle: supervised upper bound: logistic regression (C 0.1, balanced) on labelled traffic + train reference, 5-fold cross-fitted, ssl1024
plan.breakdown: speaker-overlap mode, spoof shares 0.90 and natural, 10 repetitions; frozen vs adapted (fold-averaged confirmatory model) on every clip outside the repetition's reference and traffic; anchor threshold from the calibration reference; subgroups with >= 20 bona fide and >= 20 spoof clips

criteria.fix_works: PGA-R, speaker-disjoint mode, at every spoof share: mean EER <= 1.02 x frozen and mean anchor FRR <= frozen FRR + 0.01 (never worse than falling back to the frozen detector; the frozen disjoint FRR itself exceeds 6% at some shares)
criteria.gain_kept: PGA-R, speaker-overlap mode: mean EER <= 0.85 x frozen at the natural share and 0.90; <= 1.02 x frozen at 0.05, 0.20, 0.50; mean anchor FRR <= 0.06 everywhere
criteria.subgroup_flag: adapted EER exceeds frozen EER by more than 1 point in a subgroup
criteria.cue_flag: a single cue (duration, leading silence) separates the classes with AUC > 0.70 (either direction)
criteria.silence: the gain survives trimming if the trimmed PGA (ssl1024) EER ratio at the natural share is <= 0.85
